meaning: The Quranic occurrence of همر is مُنْهَمِر in 54:11, describing water pouring down abundantly. Wider classical senses are secondary to this Quranic usage.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning_source_gm8: The root همر (hmr) primarily means to pour out, like water or tears. It can also refer to drawing out all the milk from an udder, giving generously from one's property, or speaking voluminously.
